Title: uTPro AI Page Builder
Description: AI-assisted page building inside the Umbraco backoffice. Adds an "AI Builder" workspace action to Documents that assembles pages from your existing Block Grid / Block List components from a plain prompt, a topic, or an attached design screenshot (optional vision input), rewrites a single block on demand, and fills every configured language variant from the source culture with preview and draft-only apply. Build needs a doc type with a block editor property; Dictionary item and Media caption/alt-text translation work on any content type. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter or a local Ollama). Ships with English and Vietnamese backoffice localizations.
